description: This file defines the CompilerRuntime class in the JmesPath namespace, which compiles and executes JMESPath expressions by generating PHP source code, caching it, and executing the compiled code.

classes.name: CompilerRuntime
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for compiling JMESPath expressions into PHP code, caching, and executing them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CompilerRuntime with optional cache directory and parser. Ensures cache directory exists.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Evaluates a JMESPath expression against provided data by dynamically generating or loading a cached PHP function.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a JMESPath expression into PHP source code and writes it to the cache file.
